reason: With 1,350 members and 27 holes this is a big decision that has to go through the ALV, and I won't put my name under a two-founder startup that has no club live yet. The pilot and escrow terms are decent, but I'll wait until Zwolle has run on it for a season and I can call their board.
objection: Another six to nine hundred euros a month on top of what we already pay, for a system no club our size has used yet. Our bar runs on cash and a card machine and our tee sheet is busy; if bookings or invoicing break mid-season, the members will hold me responsible.
would_change_my_mind: Several clubs, at least one of comparable size, live for a full season with references I can phone, plus a cost comparison showing our total software bill goes down rather than up.
